rules.rationale: The complete final A13 audio HAL tree is byte-identical in Android 16 except for the additional libhardware include path required by the A16 header layout.
rules.necessity: All surviving audio HAL history contributes to the selected audio.primary.bst implementation.
rules.performance: Runtime PCM routing, buffering and card selection are unchanged; the target delta is build-only.
rules.security: No new device access or IPC surface beyond the final A13 HAL.
validation_evidence: Recursive final-tree comparison found only Android.mk different; audio HAL dependency builds passed.

rules.rationale: The final A13 lights HAL source is byte-identical; Android 16 only adds the vendor libhardware include path.
rules.necessity: Required for lights.bst backlight discovery and control.
rules.security: No new device paths or permissions are introduced.
validation_evidence: Recursive final-tree comparison found only Android.mk different; lights HAL built.

rules.rationale: The dummy memtrack implementation is byte-identical; Android 16 only adds current libhardware/libsystem include paths.
rules.necessity: Required by the selected memtrack.bst product contract.
rules.performance: Runtime behavior is unchanged and remains minimal.
rules.security: No new memory disclosure behavior is added.
validation_evidence: Recursive final-tree comparison found only Android.mk different; memtrack target built.

rules.rationale: The BlueStacks power HAL source is byte-identical; Android 16 only adds current libhardware/libsystem include paths.
rules.necessity: Required by the selected power.bst module.
rules.security: No new control surface beyond the final A13 HAL.
validation_evidence: Recursive final-tree comparison found only Android.mk different; power target built.

rules.rationale: All final A13 camera files are retained. Four reviewed differences mark the module vendor, replace removed String8::string calls with c_str, drop a removed cutils header, and widen MessageQueue arg0 to prevent 64-bit pointer truncation.
rules.necessity: Required for camera.bst and its HAL3 implementation on android_x86_64.
rules.performance: No new processing stage; pointer widening and API substitutions have negligible cost.
rules.security: The 64-bit fix removes memory-corruption risk without expanding camera access.
validation_evidence: Recursive final-tree comparison isolated exactly four adapted files; camera component build history passed, runtime capture remains pending.
